scope: Direct block finality or genesis migration-anchor evidence under a separately trusted checkpoint; no activation or ancestry proof

rules.slow: Verified Notar and Finalize for one slot/context; each >=60%, block bound by Notar
rules.genesis: Verified Genesis at >=82%; anchor scope only

monocle_restrictions: Explicit target block ID for block/migration claims
Genesis and ordinary scopes cannot be mixed
No fallback, Base3, indirect ancestry, or certificate-kind promotion
Prefer fast; lexical same-kind witness ID; slow witnesses Notar then Finalize
validation: Source review and synthetic native/WASM corpus; full Agave runtime not executed
